text:
Nina Ortiz: Candidate Aisha Noor (Backend SWE) requested to pick up the loaner at a coworking hub instead of home delivery for security.
Ethan Park: Which hub? We need partner confirmation for ID check + signature.
Samira (Recruiter): Candidate prefers WeWork Berlin Mitte. She can pick up Mon or Wed next week between 11:00-15:00 CET. Also flagged: must complete background-check before device release.
Nina Ortiz: Policy requires signed LOA + BG clear before release. Samira, confirm LOA and BG status.
Samira (Recruiter): LOA emailed and signed copy uploaded. BG form sent; candidate started but not finished. I'll nudge.
Jules: For pickup I need partner contact and pickup code; give me 24-48h to coordinate.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Coworking pickups require partner confirmation and photo ID on pickup. See internal doc.
Ethan Park: Scheduling note: candidate window 11:00-15:00 CET. Panel is mostly PDT; 11:00 CET = 02:00 PDT. Can we do hybrid: two live interviews + one recorded exercise?
Nina Ortiz: Yes, that reduces panel strain. Samira, propose a slot and capture fallback.
Samira (Recruiter): Candidate can do Mon 2026-06-08 12:00 CET (03:00 PDT). She confirmed pickup 11:30-12:30 CET.
Jules: WeWork replied: pickup approved. Use subject "Redwood pickup - Aisha Noor - Pickup code: RW-8421". They require ID and signature.
PeopleOps Bot: Asset tag RW-2026-671 created. Note: device release requires verified BG and LOA.
Ethan Park: Panel volunteers: Alex can do early, Morgan declined, Priya needs flex. Nina, can you backstop?
Nina Ortiz: I'll backstop but prefer recorded exercise.
Samira (Recruiter): Invite sent with pickup details, LOA, and checklist. Candidate confirmed: "Ok for 12:00 CET — will pick up at WeWork 11:30-12:30." :thumbsup:
Jules: I'll prepare partner instructions and asset image; device is encrypted with enterprise VPN.
PeopleOps Bot: Checklist reminder: LOA signed, BG clear, partner confirmation, pickup code, ID required.
Nina Ortiz: Great. I'll log a post-interview candidate experience survey. Thanks team.
